_comment: Blocked recipe for the active spell-ray entry point. A Wizard starts with force bolt; Z selects cast-spell, a selects force bolt, and l aims east. C enters spell.c:spelleffects -> zap.c:weffects and its SPE ray arm calls zap.c:ubuzz. JavaScript weffects() still refuses that arm with UnsupportedZapError, so this recipe intentionally has no recording until the source path is ported.
